description: Watch the USER with an instant-replay buffer, hands-free. Like observe, but instead of recording the whole session it keeps only the last few seconds in a rolling buffer; whenever the user clicks MARK (or runs `marey mark`) the moment that just happened is saved as a clip. Use this for "it just glitched — did you see that?": the bug is unpredictable or intermittent, so the user cannot start a recording before it happens. You call replay, tell the user to click Mark right after each glitch and Finish when done, and you receive one contact sheet per marked moment. Multiple marks return multiple clips. A max-duration safety limit always returns. If no browser can open, the control URL is printed to the server log and the user can mark/finish with `marey mark` / `marey finish`.

cols.description: Thumbnails per contact-sheet row. Overrides the detail preset.

fps.description: Target frames per second (default 15). Check achieved FPS and gaps in the result; short events can still fall between frames. The rolling buffer holds windowSeconds × fps frames.

maxSeconds.description: Safety cap: auto-finish after this many seconds if the user never clicks Finish (default 600, max 1800).

rect.description: Capture only this rectangle, in pixels relative to the selected display/window. Applied during recording, not only to output thumbnails.

thumbWidth.description: Thumbnail width in pixels. Overrides the detail preset.

title.description: Window-title substring to match when region is "window".

windowId.description: Stable native window ID from list_windows. Preferred over title; requires region:"window".

windowSeconds.description: Look-back window kept in the rolling buffer, in seconds (default 20, max 120). Each Mark saves the frames from the last this-many seconds.

name: replay
